# Poly Pizza models

Individual low-poly models downloaded from [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza) on 2026-10-14 as GLB files. Each one is listed on its page as **Public Domain (CC0)**, so no attribution is required. The files are unmodified; only the file names were changed. The project's glTFast package (`com.unity.cloud.gltfast`) imports them.

They dress Cinna Cirra's ice trial (`C03.IceTrial`) and form the Out of Alignment relic. `Lumenfall/World/Build C03 Ice Trial Art` (`Assets/_Project/Editor/C03IceTrialArtTool.cs`) builds the project prefabs and materials from them, so these files are not edited directly.
